svg.title: Selected configurations, sampling probabilities, and Hubbard energy
svg.desc: Independent two-site Hubbard calculation with t=1, U=4, and one electron of each spin. Ritz energies for two, three and four configurations are 0, -0.449489743 and -0.828427125. The exact-state and uniform distributions both have support on all four occupation strings. The order is site1-up, site2-up, site1-down, site2-down.

cc:Work.dc:title: Selected configurations, sampling probabilities, and Hubbard energy
cc:Work.dc:description: Independent two-site Hubbard calculation with t=1, U=4, and one electron of each spin. Ritz energies for two, three and four configurations are 0, -0.449489743 and -0.828427125. The exact-state and uniform distributions both have support on all four occupation strings. The order is site1-up, site2-up, site1-down, site2-down.
